CREATE CONSTRAINT TRIGGER metadata_change_proof AFTER UPDATE ON wb.project DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION wb.metadata_change_proof()
CREATE TRIGGER metadata_governance_advance BEFORE INSERT OR DELETE OR UPDATE OF project_id OR TRUNCATE ON wb.project FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION wb.metadata_governance_advance()

CREATE TRIGGER metadata_new_project AFTER INSERT ON wb.project FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION wb.metadata_project_insert()
CREATE TRIGGER acl_revision_changed AFTER INSERT OR DELETE OR UPDATE ON wb.project_acl FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION wb.acl_revision_changed()
CREATE TRIGGER date_relation_revision BEFORE UPDATE ON wb.release_batch FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION wb.date_relation_revision()

CREATE CONSTRAINT TRIGGER require_date_audit AFTER UPDATE ON wb.release_batch DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED FOR EACH ROW WHEN (old.release_date IS DISTINCT FROM new.release_date OR old.revision IS DISTINCT FROM new.revision) EXECUTE FUNCTION wb.check_date_audit()
